invariants.rationale: Since Option is typically a non-null object representing either presence or absence, the returned Option should not be null.
The method's declared return type is Option<HoodieCompactionPlan>, so the result should always be of type Option.
instantTime is generally expected to be a non-null string representing the scheduled compaction instant.
context is required by the scheduling operation and is expected to be non-null at method exit.
extraMetadata is of type Option<Map<String, String>>, and is expected to be non-null (the Option container itself, regardless of presence or absence).
